mechanics.name: Friendly Competition
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, the Survivors who finished repairing it repair 10% faster for 80/85/90 seconds.
activation: You must complete a Generator while at least one other Survivor is also repairing it.
Ends/deactivates when: Each affected Survivor's repair-speed bonus expires after 80/85/90 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Increased cooperative repair bonus from 5% to 10% and reduced its duration from 100/110/120 to 80/85/90 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Completing a Generator cooperatively gives all finishing participants a 10% repair-speed bonus for a tiered duration.
specialInteractions: The repair-speed bonus affects every Survivor who participated in that Generator's repair, including the perk user.

editorial.summary: Finish a Generator cooperatively and every finisher repairs 10% faster for up to 90 seconds afterward.
useCases: Carry a cooperative generator completion into faster work on the next objective.
Buff multiple Survivors from one successful co-op finish.
Coordinate a SWF split after completion so several generators benefit from the same 10% bonus.
counters: The perk does nothing before that first qualifying completion.
Ten percent is useful but not enough to justify inefficiently stacking generators just to trigger it.
pros: Rewards a common objective event rather than a niche side task.
cons: Can tempt players into unnecessary generator stacking.
No direct chase or rescue value.
analysis: Friendly Competition doubled its repair bonus in 10.2 from 5% to 10%, while shortening the duration to 80/85/90 seconds. That trade strongly favors the perk because the bonus is large enough to shape the next objective rather than merely decorate it.

The correct macro remains “finish together, then split.” Every participating Survivor carries the buff away from the completed generator, so coordinated teams can turn one co-op finish into pressure on several different objectives.
The activation still creates a risk of over-stacking. Survivors should not crowd a generator solely to trigger the perk when separate repairs would have been stronger.
At 10%, however, the payoff is now substantial enough to justify a serious re-rank. The old 5% evaluation understates the live version.
editorial.verdict: A real objective snowball perk after the 10.2 buff. Finish one generator together, then spread the 10% bonus across the map.
